reviewed_changes.review: Explicit NPQ1/2/3 constructors and isolated DDL/schema domains; selected packet codecs and projected-header lengths; state grammar and current storage-schema readback; timestamp propagation for actual block/proposal execution. Legacy constructor requires Legacy profile. No packet fallback is added; current caller/owner bindings remain checked.
Authenticated cold packet reader uses the exact Settings-selected decoder. Legacy selection still dispatches Packet::decode; NPQ profiles require their own exact decoder.
Only imports Packet explicitly after it stopped arriving through the parent wildcard import. Existing test function and assertion ASTs have no body changes.

Runs PQ1 state-membership/key/authority validation before cached state-root arithmetic. The validator returns without changing legacy state when the PQ1 profile is not enabled. No SQL or acceptance verdict cache is introduced.
